_comment: Maintained by scripts/rate_check (morning rate-checker). Per-box rates (Box Engine v2): ceil(Shippo USPS Ground Advantage at the box's representative billable weight + per-box packaging + 2.00 buffer). Four bands keyed to the USPS zone map from origin 26651 (zone_1=USPS zone 3, zone_2=USPS zone 4, zone_3=USPS zone 5, zone_4=USPS zone 6); each band's rate is its worst-case (highest-USPS-zone) reference ZIP so no in-band destination is undercharged (GOL-1495). Design: vault wiki/Software/Grove Shipping.
